downloadArchivedSubmission checks only a global instructor/school_admin role and then reads an archive file from an attacker-controlled folder/filename with no check that the folder belongs to a course the instructor teaches, allowing an instructor to read another course's private submission archive.
Privileged mutation has no durable audit-log record, though this repository's own audit-log convention proves one exists and is reachable.

viewCohortInsights: after a legit canTeachCourse check on the attacker-chosen cohort, requesting client-controlled dataLevel='elevated' executes an unscoped query over ALL gradeHistory rows joined to submissions with no cohort/course predicate, disclosing private grade-change records of every course to an instructor/TA of one cohort.

viewCourseInsights: same elevated path dumps every gradeHistory row system-wide regardless of the cohort selected; the grantedElevated branch trusts only role/enrollment in the chosen cohort but returns all tenants' grade history.

viewPartnerCostAllocation uses processAllocation (unsigned decodeJwt) so the cohortId is fully attacker-forged; the enrollments query at this line then returns any cohort's enrollment rows, with the full list exposed when the forged role claim equals 'partner_admin' - no binding to an authenticated institution.

An AES-CBC decryption failure (invalid padding) is distinguishable from other failures through an externally observable response (tagged-result), without a prior authentication/integrity check — a CBC padding oracle.

The route trusts assertion.cohortId that came from processAllocation() which decodes the partner JWT with decodeJwt WITHOUT signature verification (src/lib/partner-integration.ts:22). An attacker can forge an assertion selecting any private cohort's id (and role 'sponsor') and read that cohort's name/seat share; the partner-allocation action additionally returns the full enrollment list when role is forged as 'partner_admin'.
